retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast tri-tone group portrait featuring a warm-to-cool vertical gradient and centered metallic display typography.
excludeWhen: minimalist black and white styles are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic group of five figures standing in a desert landscape, processed with a vibrant tri-tone gradient map (red-orange-blue). The composition is anchored by large, centered metallic numerals and wide-tracked serif text in the upper third.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical color transition from warm sky to cool shadows
High-contrast thresholding on figures to create graphic silhouettes
Symmetrical balance between the central large numerals and flanking text
Interaction between the organic landscape and sharp, metallic typography
coreInvariants: Beveled metallic texture on central numerals

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five full-body figures arranged horizontally across the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: Large, beveled metallic numerals centered in the upper half.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright central numerals, move outward to the flanking text, then down to the high-contrast figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive gradient sky in the upper third provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the midtones with extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to a tri-tone map plus metallic silver

characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerals feature a 3D beveled effect with a chrome-like gradient
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between flat, wide-tracked white text and large, textured metallic numerals.

avoid: Flat colors for the central numbers

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high-contrast serif skeleton.
Offers a more modern, fashion-forward serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of five women in fashionable attire standing in a desert with a car. Apply a tri-tone gradient map: deep blue for shadows, vibrant orange for midtones, and bright red-pink for highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered, wide-tracked white serif text in the upper third. Place large, chrome-beveled numerals in the center, overlapping the text.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly tri-tone?
Is the text tracking extremely wide?
Do the central numbers have a metallic 3D bevel?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
The exact facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Smooth color transitions in the sky gradient
High-contrast graphic separation of the figures

postGenerationChecks: Check that the blue shadows are deep and saturated.
Ensure the metallic bevel on the numbers looks reflective.
Verify the serif text is perfectly centered and legible.
Confirm the gradient transition is vertical and smooth.
recipe.reuseFormula: Tri-tone Gradient Map + Wide-Tracked Serif + Metallic Centerpiece
